mode.title: What to fetch
mode.description: directory = every listed company with market cap, industry and five day move, in a single request. announcements = the latest announcements per company, each carrying the ASX price sensitive flag. keyStatistics = fundamentals, dividend and franking per company.

symbols.title: ASX codes
symbols.description: ASX codes such as BHP, CBA, CSL. Use the plain code, not BHP.AX. Leave empty to let the filters below choose the companies for you.

industry.title: Industry contains
industry.description: Match part of the industry name, for example Energy, Materials, Software. Used when no codes are given.

minMarketCap.title: Minimum market cap (AUD)
minMarketCap.description: Drop companies below this market cap. Companies with no published cap are dropped when this is set.

minFiveDayMovePct.title: Minimum five day move (%)
minFiveDayMovePct.description: Keep only companies whose five day price change is at least this big in either direction. 10 means moved 10% up or down.

recentListingsOnly.title: Recent listings only
recentListingsOnly.description: Keep only companies ASX flags as recently listed, for tracking new floats.

priceSensitiveOnly.title: Price sensitive announcements only
priceSensitiveOnly.description: Announcements mode only. ASX listing rules require companies to mark announcements expected to move the price, so this is the regulator's own flag rather than a guess. Each company exposes only its 5 most recent announcements, so turning this on can return very little on a quiet week.

newOnly.title: Only announcements not seen before
newOnly.description: Announcements mode only. Remembers what it has already returned across runs, so a scheduled run reports only what is new.

maxRows.title: Maximum rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows. Billing is per row.
